W2_docred_range_matched_mde.description: DocRED range-matched: MDE for 2-sample t-test comparing count_16 vs count_32 BCS effects
W2_docred_range_matched_mde.interpretation: MDE at 80% power = 5.5pp >> observed interaction = 0.9pp. The null interaction is consistent with both (a) no true count×BCS interaction and (b) a true but small (<5pp) interaction that this sample is underpowered to detect.

W3_ner_null_power.description: NER (Few-NERD) BCS-null power analysis: absence of evidence vs evidence of absence
W3_ner_null_power.comparison: Few-NERD BCS SD (0.027) is 19.4% of FewRel's (0.141). FewRel's observed r=-0.570 would attenuate to r=-0.111 under this SD compression, yielding only 65.1% power (n=450). Min detectable |r| at 80% power = 0.132. The Few-NERD BCS-null is thus better attributed to insufficient BCS variance (most types have similar embeddings) than to a genuine absence of the BCS-accuracy relationship in NER.
